extracted.name: Beef Stroganoff with Ground Beef
extracted.description: Ground beef is used in place of beef strips in this simple and fast beef stroganoff sauce recipe, which tastes great over noodles or mashed potatoes.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
0.75 cup sour cream, or more to taste
1 tablespoon liquid smoke, or to taste
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add mushrooms and onions and saute until onions have turned translucent, about 5 minutes. Add ground beef and cook and stir until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Sprinkle with flour, garlic powder, seasoning salt, paprika, and pepper; stir until mixed in.
Add condensed soup, sour cream, liquid smoke, and Worcestershire sauce. Reduce heat to medium, and cook and stir until sauce has thickened, 5 to 7 minutes.
